title: The front desk calls your room
scenario: At 11:40 p.m., your room phone rings. “Front desk” says the hotel’s system lost your card authorization during a software update and asks you to read the card number again so they do not wake you later.

answers.A: Hang up and call the front desk using the button/number provided by the hotel, or walk down if practical.
answers.B: Ask the caller to state your reservation name and checkout date before deciding whether to continue.
answers.C: Give only the last four digits first; if they match the record, provide the rest.

explanation: A call routed to your room can still be spoofed or socially engineered. Re-establish the conversation through a channel you initiate.
proTip: If someone calls for secrets, hang up and call back on your terms.
